notes.title: Demo Reopened and Beta Version Update
notes.notes:
Greetings players! It's been a while.

Over the past few months since the demo was taken down, we have been hard at work fixing issues from the previous build and improving the core gameplay loop. Today, we're excited to announce the demo will be available again! The game has also now entered beta, with various systems being more complete. We welcome everyone to come try out the new gameplay modes and content!

Here's a quick overview of changes and new features in this build:

New Modes
In addition to the original training mode, we've added an adventure mode with more randomness and core gameplay, as well as an endless mode for pushing your limits through unlimited challenges.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/9ed4b2b7a460185f408ddd7d22077ee9179db767.png
Although only some levels are available in the current demo, we'll continue updating it and work hard to deliver more content in the full release!

Randomized Maps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/f67b25bbe56a62de7ff3abdc4a22c137af3ccb21.png
Unlike the fixed training maps previously, the new modes feature procedural generation for more diverse gameplay each run.

Quest System
The new quest system provides objectives and rewards for each map. Players can pick missions and levels suiting their party's needs, adding more strategy to map selection.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/6f5f281900d15b29653e2725df2b218cfc30c8a9.png

Voidmist System
The Voidmist system is another core feature. In this version, we've improved it to create an experience unlike other games.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/c7d3250f852d7c23f91a2c51a2c7dd41d59fd95d.png
In short, Voidmist gradually increases as players explore the map. With higher Voidmist levels, enemies have a chance to gain Voidmist enhancements, requiring more careful path selection strategies.

Voidmist effects also differ each run, incentivizing repeated play.

Card Upgrades
Campfires now offer card upgrades with branching choices, in addition to healing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/793dab12dede714cbd053f013f8b96d406be680d.png

Multi-Character Combat
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223348/92e39a4d6a3ba37bb488eac0884df09395554eee.png
Based on feedback, we've streamlined the combat flow when using multiple characters, removing the need to activate each character every turn. But you can still adjust turn order mid-fight. This should reduce the operational burden while retaining strategic depth.

Other
The above covers only some of the changes. Here are some other updates to discover in-game:


 UI improvements
 New music/sound effects
 More cards and enemies
 Ending screen


We hope you'll enjoy all the new content! Please let us know your thoughts. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: [Demo update] English version released! (Alpha 1.5.2)
notes.notes:
Dear players,
From Alpha 1.5.2, Emblem of Valor Demo now officially supports English!
We have also made following fixes and improvements:

Alpha 1.5.2
◆ Interface Updates
- Added enemy targeting effect at the start of each round
- Card details magnifying glass now only appears when hovering over a card
- Mouse hover over hand cards now displays detailed information on the right side of the screen during battles
- Added icon representations for attack type, status, hand cards, energy, armor, health, and card targets

◆ Balance Adjustments
- Revised recover effect: Gain regeneration equal to the number of layers when taking damage
- Slime's starting recover layers reduced from 3 to 2
- Adjusted Trinity effect: Cost reduced by 1 when selecting three cards of the same type

◆ Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when using Void Strike to kill an enemy by its discarded effect
Fixed an issue where some enemies were missing close attack attributes in their attacks

◆ Other
- Added English translation
- Updated some card illustrations
- Updated display of chant cards 
- Simplified some card descriptions

Alpha 1.5.1
◆ Interface Updates
- Display target when hovering over monster actions
- Updated defeat and victory screens

◆ Balance Adjustments
-Skeleton (Attack: 7 => Attack: 6) (Attack: 5/Armor: 5 => Attack: 4/Armor: 4)
- Spider (Attack: 5/Poison: 2 (no armor) => Attack: 4/Poison: 2 (no armor))
- Adjusted spike damage from status damage to physical damage

◆ Mechanics Update
Chant cards will not disappear when switching characters

notes.title: Emblem of Valor - 2023 Update roadmap
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce the Emblem of Valor demo version earlier this month, we are also actively working on adding an English version and plan to release it in our next game update. For English players, we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding.

We would also like to share with you our development plans for the rest of the year.

Q2-Q3 2023: Improvement of Core Game Features (Simultaneous Update with Demo Version)

For the next two quarters, our main focus will be on improving the existing systems and gameplay experience of the game, as well as addressing the feedback and issues from the demo version. The specific items are as follows:

1. Support for multiple languages.
2. Addition of victory screen.
3. Improve the visual display of card effects and descriptions.
4. Improve the process of multi-character battles and target selection of cards.
5. Battle and quest logs.
6. Improve our art and sound effects.
7. Addition of game content, including cards, items, equipment, etc.
8. Balance adjustments.
9. Other minor improvements.

Q4 2023 - Q1 2024: Early Access Content for Official Release

Around the end of this year or early next year, if there are no major obstacles during development, we plan to release the game officially on Steam in early access mode. The official release version will have the following major differences compared to the demo version, and will be our main development focus in the latter half of this year:

1. More classes and characters.
2. More cards, items, and equipment.
3. Main storyline.
4. Randomly generated quests and levels.
5. Difficulty adjustments and advanced challenges.
6. Meta progression elements.

The above is our development plan for the game's future. In addition to the items mentioned above, we have many ideas that we are still considering, but they may not necessarily appear in future versions. Our main goal is to deliver a complete gaming experience to our players! If you have any questions about the above plan, please feel free to let us know.

Finally, if you enjoy our game, please consider adding it to your wishlist and supporting us!

notes.title: Emblem of Valor Demo (English version now available!)
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that after over two years of development, Emblem of Valor has finally launched its first public demo version on Steam, and the English version is also supported now! This version includes two different character classes and three levels in the training mode. It also features the core experience of multi-character battles, job switching, and the Mist system. We hope you have a great time playing!

As developers, it is truly heartwarming to see our game on Steam and we are grateful for the players who have tried it out and provided feedback along the way. Being our first game on Steam, Emblem of Valor still has room for improvement in various aspects. With the release of this demo version, we hope to gain a better understanding of players' thoughts and gradually make the game more mature and enjoyable.

Lastly, if you enjoy our game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to show your support! Thanks for all the support and have a great day!
